faq.question: How long does shipping take?
faq.answer: Shipping times vary depending on the destination and service selected. Express deliveries typically take 2-5 business days, while standard shipping can take 7-14 business days. You'll get an estimated delivery date when you create your shipment.

faq.question: What items are prohibited from shipping?
faq.answer: We prohibit shipping of hazardous materials, flammable items, explosives, weapons, illegal substances, perishable foods without proper packaging, and items that violate international trade regulations. For a complete list, please visit our Prohibited Items page.

faq.question: How can I track my shipment?
faq.answer: All shipments come with a tracking number. You can track your package in real-time by entering your tracking number on our website's tracking page or through the tracking link sent to your email.

faq.question: Do you offer insurance for shipped items?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer cargo insurance for all shipments. Basic coverage is included, and you can purchase additional insurance based on the declared value of your items for extra protection.

faq.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and bank transfers for business accounts.

faq.question: How do I calculate shipping costs?
faq.answer: You can calculate shipping costs using our online calculator. Simply enter the origin, destination, weight, and dimensions of your package to get an instant quote.
